name: @bunest/typeorm
description: TypeORM integration for Bunest with 100% @nestjs/typeorm v12 API parity, multi-DataSource DI lifecycle, and zero-dep Bun SQLite/in-memory adapter

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --format esm --external @bunest/common --external @bunest/core --external reflect-metadata --external bun:sqlite
